narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Why ask for reasons at all? Collect enough readings, and more data will answer every question.
<bookmark mark='empty'/>More readings tell us what happens. They do not tell us why it happens, and that is a different question.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A why question needs a cause, such as the land, the hills or the sea.
